name: SELL YOUR OUTFIT
desc:
Earn Coins when someone buys your avatar OR when you buy someone else's avatar!
Use your Coins to unlock avatar items you can wear in every Roblox game

How to Play:
• Claim a booth and display your outfits. ✨
• Browse and try on outfits before buying. 🛍️
• Earn Coins from outfit sales and purchases. 🎁
• Redeem your Coins for avatar accessories that stay in your Roblox inventory. 🎩

Publish Community Outfits to show your outfits globally and earn Coins from every sale! 
VIP Servers are FREE!

✅ All purchases made in-game will be available in your Roblox inventory & can be used in all games.

llm.loop: claim a booth and display outfits -> others try on and buy your avatar -> earn coins on sales and purchases -> redeem coins for real UGC items that stay in your Roblox inventory
llm.objectives: sell outfits and earn real avatar items
llm.instructions: claim a booth, display outfits, browse, buy, earn, redeem
unique: coins redeem for real avatar items usable in every game
llm.thumbnails: 'buy pls' booth with a crying seller and a 999 Robux sign; CREATE, EARN, FREE UGC flow
llm.complexity_notes: outfit capture and UGC catalog integration
